[[Center (basketball)|Center]] | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1991|8|9}} | birth_place = [[İzmir]], [[Turkey]] | death_date = | death_place = | team = [[Galatasaray Medical Park (men's basketball)|Galatasaray Medical Park]] | number = 19 | college = | nationality = [[Turkey|Turkish]] | draft = | draft_team = | draft_year = | career_start = 2007 | years1 = 2007–2011 | team1 = [[Pınar Karşıyaka]] | years1 = 2011– | team1 = [[Galatasaray Medical Park (men's basketball)|Galatasaray Medical Park]] | awards = }} '''Furkan Aldemir''' (born August 9, 1991 in [[İzmir]], [[Turkey]]) is a [[Turkey|Turkish]] professional basketball player. He currently plays with [[Galatasaray Medical Park (men's basketball)|Galatasaray Medical Park]]. He is 2.07 m (6 ft 9 in) tall and 105 kg (230 lbs) weight. He mainly plays the [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] position, but he can also play as a [[Center (basketball)|center]] if needed. ==Pro career== He made his professional debut in the [[Turkish Basketball League]] with [[Pınar Karşıyaka]] during the 2007-2008 season. He signed a contract with [[Galatasaray Medical Park (men's basketball)|Galatasaray Medical Park]] in July of 2011 after playing 4 years for [[Pınar Karşıyaka]]. ==Turkish national team== Aldemir was a regular [[Turkey men's national under-20 basketball team|Turkish youth national team]] player. Impressive in [[2010 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship|2010 U20 European Championship]] where he averaged 11.6 rebounds per game.
